name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9: China (PLA) on the full 0.7.0-dev.58 game. 0.9.2-dev.2 (19 Nov): China helicopter rebalance against US/RU (Z-10 family, Z-19G Recon, Z-21, Z-9 family and Z-11WB prices; 42 loadout prices; China helicopter missiles 12 damage; TY-90 high altitude 500 m; Z-9 flares 15) and China infantry armour matching vanilla (Airborne, Marines, Marine Recon, Pathfinders, Marine teams, Weapons Squad 8; Combat Engineers 10). Includes everything in 0.9.2-dev.1. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.48.
